follow.description: Actor id to follow from `at` (for `duration`, or until the next follow/frame); null stops

axes.description: follow: track only x (default) or x and y

deadZone.description: follow: half size of the zone the actor can move in without moving the camera

lookAhead.description: follow: lead the camera by this many seconds of the actor's velocity

frame.description: Keep these actors/props framed (auto position + zoom) from `at`; null stops

padding.description: frame: margin around the targets in scene px (default 80)

blend.description: follow/frame: transition time in and out (default 0.6 s)

punch.description: Punch-in zoom: quick zoom multiplier pulse (e.g. 0.15)

handheld.description: Handheld drift amplitude in px (0 = locked off)

dolly.description: Vertigo/dolly zoom: background scale vs subject (0 = none)

focus.description: Depth in focus: a parallax value or an actor/prop/layer id

blur.description: Depth-of-field strength: max blur in screen px (0 = off)

focusRange.description: Depth distance at which blur reaches `blur` (default 0.5)

mode.description: out = cover, in = uncover, outIn = cover then uncover (default)

target.description: iris center: actor/prop id or scene point (default screen center)

actor.description: Attach to this actor (follows it, flips and scales with it)

anchor.description: Actor anchor (default "head" if present); "origin" = between the feet
